name: Akiko Yosano
shortBio: Japanese feminist essayist, anti-war philosopher, and classical translator who championed female economic independence, pacifist individualism, and bodily autonomy during Japan's Taisho debates.
centralQuestion: Does maternal welfare dependence on the state compromise women's ethical autonomy compared to equal education and independent economic labor?

keyWorks.title: On the Protection of Motherhood (Bosei Hogo Ronsō Essays)
keyWorks.description: Key philosophical intervention arguing against state-paternalist subsidies in favor of full gender economic independence.

keyWorks.title: Modern Japanese Translation of The Tale of Genji
keyWorks.description: Reclaimed Heian female aesthetic philosophy for modern Japanese cultural consciousness.
